title: Problem Overview
content: Erdős Problem #1131: Lagrange Basis Polynomial Integrals. Status: OPEN

title: Nodeconfig
content: A configuration of n nodes in [-1, 1].

title: Aredistinct
content: Nodes are distinct (required for Lagrange interpolation). ∀ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j → nodes i ≠ nodes j

title: Lagrangebasis
content: The Lagrange basis polynomial value l_k(x) at point x. l_k(x) = ∏_{i≠k} (x - xᵢ) / ∏_{i≠k} (xₖ - xᵢ) (Finset.univ.filter (· ≠ k)).prod (fun i => (x - nodes i) / (nodes k - nodes i))

title: Lagrangeintegral
content: I(x₁,...,xₙ) = ∫₋₁¹ Σₖ |l_k(x)|² dx The integral of the sum of squared Lagrange basis polynomials.

title: Lagrangebasis Self
content: **Interpolation property**: l_k(xₖ) = 1 for each k. (k : Fin n) : lagrangeBasis n nodes k (nodes k) = 1

title: Lagrangebasis Other
content: **Orthogonality**: l_k(xⱼ) = 0 for j ≠ k. (k j : Fin n) (hkj : k ≠ j) : lagrangeBasis n nodes k (nodes j) = 0

title: Lagrangeintegral Lower Bound
content: **Lower bound**: I(x₁,...,xₙ) ≥ 2/n for any configuration.  This follows because the l_k form a partition of unity at the nodes, and by Cauchy-Schwarz, the integral is bounded below. (hd : AreDistinct n nodes) (hrange : ∀ i, -1 ≤ nodes i ∧ nodes i ≤ 1) : lagrangeIntegral n nodes ≥ 2 / n

title: Lagrangeintegral Upper Bound
content: **Upper bound for equidistant nodes**: I is bounded above by 2 for any n. (hd : AreDistinct n nodes) (hrange : ∀ i, -1 ≤ nodes i ∧ nodes i ≤ 1) : lagrangeIntegral n nodes ≤ 2 * n

title: Chebyshevnodes
content: The Chebyshev nodes of the first kind: xₖ = cos((2k+1)π/(2n)). These are the roots of the Chebyshev polynomial Tₙ. fun k => Real.cos ((2 * (k : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi / (2 * n))

title: Chebyshevnodes In Range
content: Chebyshev nodes lie in [-1, 1]. -1 ≤ chebyshevNodes n k ∧ chebyshevNodes n k ≤ 1

title: Chebyshevnodes Distinct
content: Chebyshev nodes are distinct. AreDistinct n (chebyshevNodes n)

title: Chebyshev Integral Estimate
content: For Chebyshev nodes, I ≈ 2 - c/n for some constant c. ∃ c : ℝ, c > 0 ∧ |lagrangeIntegral n (chebyshevNodes n) - (2 - c / n)| ≤ c / n ^ 2

title: Minlagrangeintegral
content: sInf {lagrangeIntegral n nodes | nodes : Fin n → ℝ}

title: Erdos 1131 Conjecture
content: **Erdős's Conjecture (OPEN)**: min I = 2 - (1 + o(1))/n.  The minimum value of the integral over all node configurations in [-1,1] satisfies min I(x₁,...,xₙ) = 2 - (1 + o(1))/n as n → ∞. ∀ ε : ℝ, ε > 0 → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, n ≥ N₀ → |minLagrangeIntegral n - (2 - 1 / (n : ℝ))| ≤ ε / n

title: Erdos 1131
content: Known: I(x₁,...,xₙ) ≥ 2/n for any configuration. For Chebyshev nodes: I ≈ 2 - c/n. Conjecture: min I = 2 - (1 + o(1))/n. (hd : AreDistinct n nodes) (hrange : ∀ i, -1 ≤ nodes i ∧ nodes i ≤ 1) : lagrangeIntegral n nodes ≥ 2 / n := lagrangeIntegral_lower_bound n hn nodes hd hrange
